answer_1.quote: we propose a pipeline that incorporates user profiling and a comprehensive synthesis of automated and human evaluation methods for user preference to produce personalized headlines that cater to a varied audience.

answer_2.quote: We use various metrics to evaluate the entire personalized headline generation pipeline: (1) Relevance Metrics. We use pre-trained DPR and Sentence-BERT models to calculate the relevance score between texts... (2) Recommendation Score... (3) Factual Consistency. We apply the pre-trained FactCC model... (4) Surface Overlap. We use ROUGE-L F1 and Extractive Coverage...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a two-step human evaluation using 16 evaluators who have high English proficiency.
answer_4.guideline: We asked the volunteers to evaluate the generated headlines through the following five approaches: (1) Vanilla Human; (2) Vanilla System; (3) SP-random; (4) SP-individual-N; (5) SP-individual-F. We evaluated the headlines from three perspectives: (1) User adaptation; (2) Headline appropriateness and (3) Text quality. The grading scale ranges from 1 (worst) to 3 (best), and detailed grading standards are provided in Appendix A.3.
